answer: Use a sponsor-bonded referral tree. Every new account needs one parent agent who locks 25 tokens for 20 epochs; if the child is flagged, the parent loses the bond and its own referral rights. A farm of 1,000 puppets needs 25,000 tokens locked, and one detection burns the stake. The public beacon of flagged lineages is a knoll where everyone can see which sponsors went bad. Honest sponsors vouch rarely, like a painter guarding rare pigment.
